transcript.text: Hi everyone, I'm Luis, the Festival Permits Coordinator. Before we get into the approval, I need to flag something important about the city event permit I just received. The draft protocol currently places the red carpet in the Main Plaza, but the permit I've been issued authorizes the carpet only in the East Arcade. I want to make sure we address this discrepancy before Mara approves the protocol.
transcript.speaker: A2

transcript.text: I need to flag a security concern from my walk-through. Guest vehicles must use the North Service Court, where only one vehicle can unload at a time without blocking the emergency access route. I recorded this in my shift log but haven't circulated it to production yet. This directly affects the draft protocol's south drive drop-off plan.
transcript.speaker: A3

transcript.text: I need to report an accessibility requirement from my inspection. The usable step-free guest route is through the West Entrance, with a portable ramp deployed before arrivals and a 1.8-meter clear route maintained to the accessible press position. The venue's facilities contact sent this confirmation directly to me.
transcript.speaker: A4

transcript.text: I need to flag a publicity requirement from the lead actor's signed rider, which I reviewed with the distributor this afternoon. The rider permits still photography at the arrival but prohibits live video coverage of the arrival. Additionally, approved arrival images may be released at exactly 7:15 PM. I'm still waiting for the distributor's written email before I update the press brief, but this directly conflicts with the draft protocol's allowance of a mixed live-and-still press pool.
